commands.step: Install npm >=11.5 in a sandbox for OIDC trusted-publishing auth
commands.text:
# Node 22 ships npm 10.9, which signs Sigstore provenance but cannot
# negotiate the OIDC auth path for trusted publishing (the PUT returns
# a misleading 404 "not in this registry"). An in-place
# `npm install -g npm@latest` races on the bundled npm's arborist
# rebuild and breaks irrecoverably; a sandbox install + PATH shadow
# avoids the race. See memory: npm-115-required-for-oidc.
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@latest
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
"$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm" --version

PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "Tag: ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} -> ${TAG_VERSION} | package.json: ${PKG_VERSION}"
if [ "${PKG_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match package.json version ${PKG_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

PY_VERSION=$(python3 -c "import tomllib; print(tomllib.loads(open('pyproject.toml').read())['project']['version'])")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "pyproject.toml: ${PY_VERSION}"
if [ "${PY_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match pyproject.toml version ${PY_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

# Extract the `## <version> — ...` section from CHANGELOG.md as notes;
# fall back to the tag name if the section is missing.
VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
NOTES_FILE="$(mktemp)"
awk -v ver="${VERSION}" '
  $0 ~ "^## " ver " " {capture=1; next}
  capture && /^## / {exit}
  capture {print}
' CHANGELOG.md > "${NOTES_FILE}"

if [ ! -s "${NOTES_FILE}" ]; then
  echo "XRPL Lab ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" > "${NOTES_FILE}"
  echo "" >> "${NOTES_FILE}"
  echo "See CHANGELOG.md for details." >> "${NOTES_FILE}"
fi

# Idempotent: skip creation if the release already exists (re-pushed
# tag / workflow_dispatch re-run). Publishing the release fires
# `release: published` -> publish-pypi.yml + release-binaries.yml.
if gh release view "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Release ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} already exists; skipping create."
else
  gh release create "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" \
    --title "XRPL Lab ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" \
    --notes-file "${NOTES_FILE}" \
    --verify-tag
fi

# Tee the run to smoke.log so the WHY of a failure is captured, not
# just a red X. The script prints only status lines and txid PREFIXES
# — never wallet.seed — so the log is safe to surface/upload. `set -o
# pipefail` keeps the python exit code (the tee would otherwise mask
# a non-zero exit). On failure the on-failure step below and the
# always-on artifact upload make smoke.log readable in the run UI.
set -o pipefail
python -c "
import asyncio
import json
from xrpl.wallet import Wallet
from xrpl_lab.transport.xrpl_testnet import XRPLTestnetTransport

async def smoke():
    transport = XRPLTestnetTransport()

    # 1. Check network
    info = await transport.get_network_info()
    assert info.connected, f'RPC not connected: {info.rpc_url}'
    print(f'RPC connected: ledger {info.ledger_index}')

    # 2. Create temp wallet and fund
    wallet = Wallet.create()
    print(f'Temp wallet: {wallet.address}')

    fund = await transport.fund_from_faucet(wallet.address)
    assert fund.success, f'Faucet failed: {fund.message}'
    print(f'Funded: {fund.balance} XRP')

    # 3. Send self-payment
    result = await transport.submit_payment(
        wallet.seed, wallet.address, '10', 'XRPLLAB|SMOKE'
    )
    assert result.success, f'Payment failed: {result.error}'
    print(f'Payment OK: {result.txid[:24]}...')

    # 4. Verify tx
    tx = await transport.fetch_tx(result.txid)
    assert tx.result_code == 'tesSUCCESS', f'Verify failed: {tx.result_code}'
    print(f'Verified: {tx.result_code}, ledger {tx.ledger_index}')

    print('Smoke test passed.')

asyncio.run(smoke())
" 2>&1 | tee smoke.log

{
  echo '### Testnet smoke failed'
  echo ''
  echo 'Last output from the smoke run (no secrets — status lines and txid prefixes only):'
  echo ''
  echo '```'
  cat smoke.log || echo '(smoke.log not produced — the run failed before any output)'
  echo '```'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
